The '''85-XS Odyssey heavy speeder bike''' was a [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]] manufactured by the [[Aratech Repulsor Company/Legends|Aratech Repulsor Company]]. It was designed for long trips in difficult terrain, and was considered easy to pilot.<ref name="FDCR" />
